visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with short, dark brown hair and black circular-rimmed glasses sits on a light beige sofa. She wears a plain white V-neck t-shirt and blue-gray striped trousers. A small black lavalier microphone is clipped to her shirt. She begins speaking and gesturing toward her face, highlighting her profile. The background is a minimalist interior with a clinic logo in the corner. (2) The scene remains static as the woman continues her explanation. She uses dynamic hand movements, pointing to specific areas around her mouth and eyes to illustrate common facial lines. At one point, she removes her glasses to show her eye area more clearly. Text overlays in Traditional Chinese appear at the bottom of the screen, sometimes accompanied by stylized variety-style captions. (3) The woman turns her head to the side, presenting her profile to the camera while continuing to point at her jawline and temple areas. She demonstrates the appearance of skin sagging and hollow areas. Her facial expressions are animated and professional, maintaining direct engagement with the viewer despite the side-on perspective. (4) The video cuts to a final static graphic card containing the full brand logo of DRX Dermatology Clinic. The card displays a QR code, social media handle @drx.derm, a telephone number, and two physical office addresses in Taipei and New Taipei City. The background of this card is a clean white with subtle gray graphics.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A clear female voice begins an energetic narration in Mandarin, maintaining a professional yet conversational tone. An upbeat, lo-fi pop background track with a steady electronic drum beat and soft synthesizer chords provides a continuous rhythmic layer at a moderate tempo of approximately 95 BPM. (2) As the speaker emphasizes specific facial features, a digital 'whoosh' transition sound effect occurs, signifying a shift in focus. The vocal prosody exhibits high pitch variability, with rising contours used for engagement and emphasis on medical terms. The background music remains constant in volume and texture. (3) A subtle 'pop' sound effect is heard as variety-style text graphics appear on screen to highlight key points about facial aging. The speaker's articulation is crisp, indicative of a high-quality studio recording environment with no detectable background noise or interference. (4) The main narration concludes with a slight drop in volume, leading into a brief musical stinger as the contact information is presented. The audio track ends with a clean fade-out of the background music, leaving a final impression of organized, high-production value medical commentary.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To educate potential clients about modern aesthetic filler techniques, specifically focusing on the importance of profile contours rather than just front-facing corrections. The video promotes DRX Dermatology Clinic by contrasting outdated filler methods with their current, natural-looking approach to facial rejuvenation.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video features the clinic's logo throughout, a spokesperson clearly representing the brand, and ends with a dedicated business card graphic providing direct contact information.

high_inference.freeDescribe: A highly effective short-form promotional video that uses educational content to build authority. The mix of professional narration and social-media-friendly editing makes it engaging for a modern audience.
